component-workbench: screen-flow artifacts are inputs; generating new screen catalogs is outside component documentation.
product-planner: to-prd and to-issues are explicitly separate downstream workflows, not required planning dependencies.
better-interface: interface-review resolves separately requested version-control change reviews; it is not invoked by a screen review.

runtime_requirements.browser-runtime: A browser/tool and its version-matched guide, workspace access, and any required login come from the session.
runtime_requirements.image-generation: An available image generation/editing tool comes from the session; paid backends require applicable authorization.
runtime_requirements.component-libraries: The selected component packages and version-specific documentation belong to the project; this bundle installs no packages.
